law.catch_line: Remedies of judgment creditor of associated member or protected series assignee
law.text:
Any provision of § 13.1-1041.1 that provides or restricts remedies available to a judgment creditor of a member of a limited liability company or owner of a membership interest of the series limited liability company applies to a judgment creditor of:
An associated member or protected series assignee of a protected series; or
A series limited liability company, to the extent the series limited liability company owns a protected series membership interest of a protected series.
